title: SS27 Boys' Trim Innovations
summary: Functional details for boys: UPF-rated components, reflective trims, scented and novelty finishes tested for skin safety.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Poco Blush, designed "almost exclusively for girls", showed bold hues and a loose, printed, reversible dress, and a T-shirt that releases a minty scent when crumpled<sup>[1]</sup>
- Sticky Lemon showed backpacks in key shades from past collections and a mini digital camera that attaches to a bag<sup>[1]</sup>
- Teeter Totter showed UPF50+ swim and sportswear, backpacks and ultra-light, sand-free beach towels<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Readiness
sections.body:
| Innovation | Readiness (Forecut assessment) |
|---|---|
| Reflective trims | Ready |
| Sand-free towel fabric | Ready |
| Scented finishes | Test skin safety first |
| Bag-attached gadgets | Accessory category; check toy rules |

design_implications:
- Skin-safety evidence for any finish.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
